source: Installed binary embedded JavaScript, inspected locally; behavior checked through the native PTY
rules: Bracketed paste begins IN_PASTE; the closing bracket emits paste text and ends that mode.
CR outside paste maps to Return; LF maps to Enter and inserts a newline.
Return during pending paste processing is deferred until the UI commit, rather than treated as a newline.
Plain Return invokes onSubmit; modifiers or the configured backslash continuation insert a newline.
Reader timeouts are 50 ms for incomplete key/byte input and 2000 ms for unfinished bracketed paste; neither is a mandatory wait after a completed closing marker.
historicalCause: The live incident did not capture native stdin bytes or key-handler state. No natural fast-CR failure was reproduced.
